name: .416 Cal-300gr Stone Hammer®
note: Required twist for Dangerous Game is 1-17″ or faster. Recommended use: Dangerous Game Hunting / Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "Designed for Dangerous Game Hunting, this Stone Hammer™ spent 2021 in South Africa getting put through the paces by Trophy Game Safari. After a year of stellar results another batch were sent for 2022. This pure copper Hammer will give extra vel and deep straight line penetration with a bit less recoil. A great setup for any of the North American game too." The weight is taken from the product name (300gr).
